text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's past our usual time for training, but
Daiwa
Scarlet still hasn't shown up. I
decide to wait, and
just as it's getting
dark...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Have you... been waiting for me here this
whole
time?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you sometimes... But,
um... sorry.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This is all because the doctor told me I
needed to
get some rest. Can you
believe that? I'm not even
tired!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I said I was fine, but that just started an

argument, and before I knew it, the sun
was going
down...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We can totally start training now,
though! I don't
have time to waste if I'm
going to become number
one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, it does seem
like Daiwa
Scarlet has been overexerting
herself lately.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: 無理しなくていいんだ
choice_data_list_en: You don't need to force yourself.
You don't have to push yourself.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Honestly, if you were any more
laid-back,
you'd fall over!
choice_data_list: 君なら絶対に大丈夫だ！
貴方なら絶対に大丈夫だよ！

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sigh... But I guess you're right. I don't want to end up too tired to train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet seems to have seen the
error of her
ways.
